english.dashboard.modal.remaining.chooseTheYouTu: Choose the YouTube space for these rules. FilterTube will respect each protected profile current Blocklist/Whitelist mode.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.forProtectedPr: For protected profiles, FilterTube blocks "send anyway" in this situation so the update does not land in the wrong remote profile.

english.dashboard.modal.remaining.afterThatChoos: After that, choose "Always this local profile" on the receiving device so future parent updates can land there without switching profiles each time.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.otherDeviceHas: Other device has a different profile open

english.dashboard.modal.remaining.sendNowTransfe: Send Now transfers directly while both verified devices are open.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.homePickupLeav: Home Pickup leaves it on your configured local-network service.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.sendForLaterLe: Send for Later leaves an encrypted signed envelope for the device to collect over the internet.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.onlyThisVerifi: Only this verified device link is targeted. The receiver still checks the signature, bound profile, and revision.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.onlyContinueIf: Only continue if both devices show the exact same phrase.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.thisPreventsTh: This prevents the signaling relay from silently impersonating one side of the session.

english.dashboard.modal.remaining.textBareRowsAr: Text: bare rows are channels; typed rows can use channel: @SomeChannel or keyword: brainrot.
english.dashboard.modal.remaining.ruleListJSONCh: Rule-list JSON: channels and keywords arrays.

english.dashboard.modal.remaining.publicURLsRawH: Public URLs: raw HTTPS CSV, text, or JSON files can be loaded into the preview.
